blockwire.settings.title: Blockwire settings
blockwire.settings.runtime_hint: Immediate endpoint toggle, like F8. Does not change startup settings or activate Python autopilot.
blockwire.settings.startup_hint: Startup preference only. Save explicitly; closing without saving discards this draft.
blockwire.settings.saved: Startup preference saved. Current control unchanged.
blockwire.settings.save_failed: Not saved; file changed or unwritable. Check local logs.
blockwire.settings.runtime_failed: Could not change control. Check local logs.
blockwire.settings.security: TLS required. API key is never displayed.
blockwire.settings.stop_hint: Local stop: F8 (or your rebound toggle key).
